content.comment_body: I keep getting this message after starting the update of [product_name] [version_no] to [version_no] on a Windows 10 laptop where other [company_name] software runs well: java.lang.ClassCastException: class [B cannot be cast to class java.lang.Integer ([B and java.lang.Integer are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap') at com.zerog.ia.installer.LifeCycleManager.getEnable8dot3(Unknown Source) at com.zerog.ia.installer.LifeCycleManager.a6(Unknown Source) at com.zerog.ia.installer.LifeCycleManager.executeApplication(Unknown Source) at com.zerog.ia.installer.Main.main(Unknown Source) at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method) at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:62) at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:43) at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:566) at com.zerog.lax.LAX.launch(Unknown Source) at com.zerog.lax.LAX.main(Unknown Source) I've tried all suggested steps: I switched from Explorer to Edge, installed Java, and ran everything with administrator rights. Can anyone help?
You should start a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a Java ClassCastException error when trying to update [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no] on Windows 10. Several troubleshooting actions have been attempted, such as switching browsers, installing Java, and running with administrator permissions. Other [company_name] software appears to be functioning normally, with the issue restricted specifically to this update process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the update for [product_name] to proceed smoothly and without errors, in line with their positive experience using other [company_name] software on the same system.
